responsibilities_block: Drive trains according to the timetable and confirm signals and track conditions.
Open and close doors at stations and depart only after confirming no person or object is trapped.
Make station announcements according to procedure and respond to onboard incidents.
Follow emergency procedures and report signal failures or equipment abnormalities.
Complete operating logs and participate in pre-shift briefings and operations reviews.
Conduct depot departure, return, and readiness inspections.
page.work_context_block: The early shift begins at the depot at half past five with a departure inspection: check the train, test the brakes, and verify the timetable. Passenger volume rises on the first run, and at every station you watch the door gap and listen to platform announcements. After the midday peak, maintain the operating rhythm and immediately confirm any temporary signal change. Stay vigilant through the evening peak, inspect the train before returning the last service to the depot, complete the operating log, and hand over the shift.
